central_thai: ท้าว่าจะลองแข่งหรือเปรียบเทียบกันไหม เอาไหมล่ะ ตามบริบท
register: informal challenge; can be playful, competitive or confrontational
usage: A standalone informal challenge: want to test/compare our ability, up for it, wanna go? วัด here refers to testing/comparing, not automatically a Buddhist temple. In gaming or sport use a challenge to compete, not physical violence. In romance it can challenge a comparison of affection; do not invent fighting, threats, stakes or a bet. Without further context keep a broad challenge such as 'Up for it?' rather than inventing a specific contest. Explicit temple, travel, worship, place-name or measurement context takes precedence: a pun may be intended. Do not change วัดไหน (which temple), ไปวัด (visit a temple), วัดป่า (forest temple), วัดปะละ (a place name) or a literal measurement into a challenge. The spelling ปะ/ป่ะ represents informal question particle เปล่า, not a request to identify which temple.

register: Context-dependent; explicit pronouns and intent take precedence.
aliases: ไหวหรือเปล่า
central_thai: ถามว่ายังรับมือได้หรือไม่ หรือแสดงความห่วงใย/ประชดตามบริบท
usage: A question about being able to cope. In a fatigue statement with omitted subject followed by this question and permission to rest, the tired person is usually the LISTENER. Do not invent first-person 'I've been working' then ask a different person 'are you okay?'. A neutral phrasing such as 'Ten hours of work already. Still holding up?' preserves uncertainty. EXPLICIT pronouns take precedence: ฉันทำงาน...แต่เธอ... really changes participants. Preserve sincere concern versus sarcasm; explicit first-person reflection must remain first-person.

register: Context-dependent; explicit pronouns and intent take precedence.
central_thai: ให้ไปพักหรือให้หยุดการกระทำ ตามบริบทและผู้ที่ถูกพูดถึง
usage: Without an explicit first-person intention, a standalone directive is addressed to the LISTENER: take a break / give it a rest. In criticism of accusing someone without reading, it tells the accuser to stop; do not turn it into the speaker announcing 'I'm going to take a break' or admitting 'I haven't read it'. If the source explicitly says ฉันขอไปพัก or ขอไปพัก, retain the speaker's own request/intention. In real fatigue preserve sincere rest advice.
match_pattern: (?<!ขอ)(?<!อยาก)(?<!จะ)ไปพักก่อน

register: Context-dependent; explicit pronouns and intent take precedence.
term: คุยเผื่อเลือก
central_thai: ทำความรู้จักเชิงความรักโดยเก็บหลายคนไว้เป็นตัวเลือก
usage: Dating several possible partners or keeping someone as an option without a committed relationship stated. This is a ROMANTIC CONTEXT CUE: in the same utterance, อยากคุยจริงจัง means wanting something serious romantically, not wanting to have a serious conversation. Preserve the contrast between serious dating intention and being one of several options. Preserve negation; do not invent cheating, sex, agreed exclusivity or official boyfriend/girlfriend status.

central_thai: คนเด่น คนเก่ง หรือคนที่เป็นตัวหลักของกลุ่ม
register: informal praise; surrounding context can be teasing
usage: A standout/top expert/main player in the specified skill or group. Not a stiff body or someone who pushes/coerces others. In fixing bugs it identifies a skilled go-to problem-solver, not a manager pressing the team to work. Preserve explicitly literal physical uses and do not invent a rank or official leadership role.

central_thai: ได้ตำแหน่งชนะ สมควรได้มง หรือคำชมว่าโดดเด่น
register: pageant-related praise, sometimes figurative
usage: Receiving/winning/deserving the crown/title, often pageant-style praise. Not a crown accidentally falling down or a loss of the crown. Preserve prediction versus a confirmed award; do not turn future certainty into an already completed win. A physical crown falling must be explicit in the source context.

central_thai: รับได้ทุกตัวเลือก ไม่เกี่ยง
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In a choice/invitation, any option works / no preference / can handle any of them. Not 'I'm full' after eating. Distinguish ability from preference and retain any negation.

central_thai: ของแท้ ของจริง เก่งจริง
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Playful spelling of ของแท้: praise for genuine quality/skill, the real deal. Not ownership by an invented person named Trae. Preserve explicitly identified names or brands.

central_thai: เก่งมาก
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Playful เทพ: highly skilled/amazing in a game or skill context, not the English noun map. Do not invent a name, origin or achievement.

central_thai: ทำให้อารมณ์หรือบรรยากาศสะดุด
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: A comment/action interrupts enjoyment or excitement: kills the mood / a buzzkill. Not a short film or electrical injury. Select the emotion and intensity from context.

sources.title: ช็อตฟีล: สำนวนว่าด้วยการเบรกอารมณ์ — The Momentum
sources.supports: Mood-interruption sense; application wording and English suggestions are editorial.

central_thai: เหนือกว่าอย่างชัดเจน
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In comparisons, clearly outclasses / wins hands down. With battery performance it praises superiority, not a battery draining completely. Do not invent a competitor or quantitative advantage.

central_thai: เฉียบ มั่นใจ หรือสับของจริงตามบริบท
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In fashion/performance or แบบสับ: confident/striking, slaying/owning the stage, not awkward. With meat/vegetables/knives: literally chop/mince. Preserve food and physical cutting; do not treat สับสน or สับปะรด as slang.

central_thai: ใจอ่อน หวั่นไหว เอ็นดูง่าย
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: With cute animals or an appealing person: soft spot / heart melts / smitten, not heart pain, sadness or heart disease. Do not invent romantic attraction to an animal.

central_thai: ตาย หรือพูดเกินจริงแสดงอารมณ์
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Slang death; often hyperbole for shock/exhaustion/laughter. In bill shock do not invent vomiting, nausea or an illness. Preserve an actual death if the surrounding text reports one.

central_thai: ตาย หรือพูดเกินจริงแสดงอารมณ์
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Colloquial death. เหนื่อยจะตุย or ขำจะตุย is figurative extreme exhaustion/laughter, not a factual death. Actual deaths must stay factual.

central_thai: กลุ่มแฟนคลับ
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Fandom / fan community around an actor, singer, series or fan activities. Not a dormitory. Do not infer that the fans live together.

central_thai: คนหรือตัวละครที่ชอบหรือใช้เป็นหลัก
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In a band/fandom: favorite member / bias. In games: main character/role. Not a new person named Men. Preserve menu, comment, domain, motherboard and menthol uses and explicitly identified personal names.

central_thai: ถูกคนจำนวนมากวิจารณ์ออนไลน์
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In a controversial-post/brand/person context: online backlash/criticism, not a canceled tour. In explicit travel context it can mean a tour arriving or disembarking. Do not invent cancellation or threats.

central_thai: ถูกอำหรือแกล้ง
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In deliberately misleading friends: getting pranked / playfully tricked, not getting scolded, assaulted or served curry. Preserve negation and who tricked whom; actual food context can still be literal.

central_thai: อำ แกล้ง หรืออาหารตามบริบท
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: With deliberately misleading friends: pranking / trolling. In food/cooking/ingredients: curry/stew. ทำแกงให้เพื่อน is cooking, not pranking; ไม่ได้แกง denies pranking. Do not invent malicious intent.

central_thai: อวด เกทับ หรือขิงที่เป็นอาหาร
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: With showing off purchases/skill to friends: bragging/flexing/one-upping. ใหญ่เลย intensifies the bragging, not a big friend. With tea, food, medicine or ingredients: literal ginger.

central_thai: ดวงสุ่มไม่ดี หรือเกลือที่เป็นส่วนผสม
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In gacha/draws with duplicates or no desired item: bad luck/disappointing pulls. English salty describes bitterness rather than bad luck itself. สุ่มตัวละคร means drawing/pulling characters, not randomizing attributes. In food/chemistry: salt; preserve grams/amounts.

central_thai: ชวนให้ซื้อหรือสนใจ หรือทายาตามบริบท
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In recommendations/shopping: hyping/recommending something, persuading someone to try/buy it. For a wound: apply/spread medication, NOT attach a medication label. Do not invent purchases or change healthcare instructions into advertising.

term: แสงออกเท้า
central_thai: ถูกกลบความเด่นในมุกเปรียบเทียบ
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In a photo/comparison beside a striking person: being overshadowed/outshone. Not showing a foot or emitting light. Retain literal lighting/effects if explicitly described.

central_thai: มีปัญหาหรือเรื่องยุ่งเข้ามา
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: After an error/difficulty: now in trouble / a problem on one's hands, not 'the job is in'. In explicit incoming-work/order context, work may literally be coming in. Do not invent damage or recovery.

central_thai: ถูกกำหนดเวลาบีบจนต้องรีบ
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Deadline pressure / up against the clock / scrambling to finish. Do NOT calque into 'my pants are on fire', which is not a usual English deadline idiom and may suggest lying. Prefer plain urgency to an invented idiom. Preserve actual fires in literal context.

term: คุยจริงจัง

usage: This entry is retrieved ONLY when a separate explicit dating cue exists in this source and no explicit work/study/budget topic is detected. In this romantic frame, คุยจริงจัง means pursuing a serious relationship / being serious about dating, NOT holding a serious conversation or discussion. Preserve whether commitment is wanted or already established; do not invent exclusivity or current partner status. In other contexts this phrase can mean a serious discussion, but that is not the selected reading for this contextual entry.

central_thai: คนที่กำลังทำความรู้จักเชิงความรัก หรือผู้สนทนาตามบริบท
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: In a not-yet-partners romantic context: talking stage / someone one is seeing, not a generic acquaintance. Preserve the absence of an official relationship. Ordinary conversation roles stay literal when explicit.

central_thai: จีบหรือหยอกเชิงชอบพอ
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Flirt / playfully hit on someone, not generic teasing or bullying. Do not invent reciprocal interest, a date or a relationship.

central_thai: ไม่สมหวัง หรือสัตว์ที่เป็นนกตามบริบท

usage: In romance/ticket-buying slang: out of luck / missed out / unsuccessful. Do not add being single again or a breakup if there was no relationship. An actual bird stays a bird.

usage: Upset/insecure/anxious/overthinking as context supports. Being left on read often feels hurt/disappointing, not necessarily angry/annoyed. Do not diagnose paranoia or invent another person's motives.

central_thai: ผิดหวัง เสียความรู้สึก หรือพลาด

central_thai: รับมือหรือจัดการได้
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Can handle/manage the situation successfully; not merely accepting or taking on the task. Preserve ability versus a completed result. เอาไม่อยู่ denies that capacity.

central_thai: ทำได้ดีและถึงระดับที่คาดหวัง
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Praises execution/performance that really delivers or meets a high standard, not simply an event having happened. ทำไม่ถึง means fell short. Do not add budgets, awards or techniques.

central_thai: คนเก่งหรือโดดเด่นระดับแนวหน้า
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Figurative expert/queen/top figure in a skill, not a biological mother. Praise mastery, not just appearance or an assigned task. Explicit family/animal/technical uses stay literal.

central_thai: คนเก่งหรือโดดเด่นระดับแนวหน้า
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Figurative expert/master/top figure in a field, not a biological father or merely someone assigned the job. Explicit family/animal/technical uses stay literal.

central_thai: สมองล้าในภาษาพูด หรือการย้ายออกของคนเก่ง

usage: After prolonged work/coding: figurative brain fried / mentally exhausted. With skilled-worker migration: brain drain. Preserve actual physical/medical events rather than turning them into jokes.

usage: For a phone/device: battery dead, charger literal. After socializing/work: drained energy / depleted social battery. Do not invent a broken device or illness.

central_thai: เชียร์ให้เป็นคู่ หรือชิปอุปกรณ์ตามบริบท

central_thai: เรียกร้องความสนใจ
register: Context-dependent; retain source register and intensity.
usage: Disapproving attention-seeking/clout chasing, not literal hunger or light. Preserve criticism without inventing harassment, crimes or another motive.

term: สาดไปสมาชิก
central_thai: จัดไปเพื่อน / เอาเลย / ลุยเลย / เต็มที่ไปเลย
register: informal, enthusiastic acceptance or encouragement between friends
usage: User-supplied contextual slang meaning: จัดไปเพื่อน, เอาเลย, ลุยเลย or เต็มที่ไปเลย. When this complete expression is an affirmative response or encouragement, สมาชิก addresses a friend; it is not a recipient list, and สาดไป is not an instruction to send, distribute or splash something. Use a natural equivalent of the speech act in the target language: for example 'Go for it, buddy!', 'Let's do it!' or 'Give it your all!' according to context. Choose one fitting reading, not a list of alternatives. Keep negation, questions, quotation and discussion about the expression intact. Surrounding literal water-splashing or delivery context takes precedence; do not reinterpret ordinary mentions of สมาชิก or สาด as slang. This meaning was supplied by the project user, not independently established as universal usage; do not invent an origin, popularity claim or extra meaning.

term: ป้อคิงหยัง
